nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Biomass energy|Advances in biomass technology_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What technological advancements have contributed to the production of sustainable fibres in the last two decades?
nodes.answer: Technological advancements in polymer science have resulted in the production of fibres like soybean protein, bamboo, Lumpur, Sea Cell, and polylactic acid (PLA), which are prepared from renewable sources and biodegradable at the end of their life cycle.
